newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks dip, volume led by foreign trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks dip, volume led by foreign trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed lower on Monday as short-term players dumped stocks, but turnover was led by foreign buying of a blue chip hotel company, brokers said.
The all share index closed 2.13 points down at 615.40. Price declines led gains by 28 to eight. Ceylon Glass fell 2.50 rupees to 20 rupees and Commercial Bank fell five rupees to 125.
Turnover, supported by foreign buying of over 900,000 shares of Asian Hotels, was 20.9 million rupees. Foreign buying was 11.2 million rupees, and selling was 12.56 million.
